name: 检查图片或视频成品
description: 质检专用。读取实际图片内容，或从平台视频自动抽取前、中、后段画面，再由视觉思考模型输出带证据的 pass/fail/blocked 报告。无法读取证据时禁止放行。
inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"inspection_type":{"type":"string","enum":["image","video"],"description":"要检查的媒体类型"},"media_urls":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"maxItems":12,"description":"实际成品 URL。图片可用 /uploads/、HTTPS 或 data:image；视频必须是平台 /uploads/ URL"},"criteria":{"description":"本批次验收标准，可传字符串或结构化对象"}},"required":["inspection_type","media_urls"]}
